# Google Earth Engine

> Google Earth Engine is a cloud-based geospatial analysis platform providing petabytes of satellite imagery and tools for environmental monitoring and research.

Earth Engine combines massive satellite imagery datasets (Landsat, Sentinel-2) with powerful processing capabilities through the Code Editor, JavaScript API, and Python client libraries. It serves academic, nonprofit, and commercial users conducting forest monitoring, climate research, and large-scale geospatial analysis on Google Cloud infrastructure.

## Key Topics

- Satellite imagery
- Geospatial analysis
- Code Editor
- JavaScript API
- Python API
- Landsat
- Sentinel-2
- Google Cloud

- Earth observation

- [Google Earth Engine](https://earthengine.google.com): Homepage for Google Earth Engine satellite imagery and geospatial analysis platform

- [FAQ](https://earthengine.google.com/faq): Frequently asked questions about Earth Engine, Landsat, Sentinel-2, and APIs

## Access & Licensing

- [Noncommercial](https://earthengine.google.com/noncommercial): Noncommercial access program for academic and nonprofit Earth Engine users
- [Commercial](https://earthengine.google.com/commercial): Commercial licensing and enterprise solutions for Earth Engine on Google Cloud
